# Contributing to Portfolio

Thank you for considering contributing to the Portfolio project! We appreciate your help and contributions.

## How to Contribute
1. **Fork the repository:** Click the fork button at the top right corner of the page.
2. **Clone your forked repository:** Use `git clone https://github.com/yourusername/Portfolio.git`
3. **Create a new branch:** Create a new branch for your feature or bugfix using `git checkout -b your-branch-name`.
4. **Make your changes:** Make your changes and test them thoroughly.
5. **Commit your changes:** Use `git commit -m "Description of your changes"` to commit your changes.
6. **Push your changes:** Push your changes to your forked repository using `git push origin your-branch-name`.
7. **Open a pull request:** Go to the original repository and click on the "New pull request" button. Select your branch and create the pull request.

## Reporting Issues
If you find a bug or have a feature request, please open an issue on the repository. Provide as much detail as possible, including steps to reproduce the issue, any error messages, and any relevant screenshots.

## Code Style
- Follow the existing code style of the project.
- Use meaningful variable and method names.
- Write comments to explain complex code.
- Ensure that your code is free of syntax errors and adheres to a consistent formatting style.

Happy contributing!
